title: Garfeldi [Cobblemon]
description: Back in 2024, I made an April Fools' addon for Cobblemon just called "Garfeldi", ironically posted to the Cobblemon server on April 2nd. I found the files, like, 10 minutes ago, made minimal changes, and decided to post it to Modrinth.
body:
This is a joke addon and I wouldn't recommend adding this to a serious world.

Garfeldi is a normal type Pokemon, based on a bit from a Saltydkdan video, that spawns in the Nether on an extremely rare chance. Don't worry, we all know you're gonna spawn it in manually anyway.
